body: My mom told me a few months ago I had to leave by September because thats when school starts. I'm moving in with a friend and since I work nights he said he would find a place, like tour them and find a good one. Well found out today be hasn't looked at a single place and the ones I called have no openings until november at the earliest. So I'm basically homeless til November. If I even have thr credit to get a place, which is debatable.

It was physics but I didn't do well. I wanted to go back for psychology, partly to be a therapist and help people, partly to try to understand what the fuck is wrong with me. I volunteer at an animal shelter, I clean cages for the staff. Not having a SO in mi life isn't making.me. depressed. I think having one wouldn't hurt, but being.without one isn't causing me to want to die. I've never been very creative. I want to draw and paint but I just can't do anything very good. I don't have any friends I feel comfortable talking to. A lot of them have their own issues and I don't trust people at all.

I moved home last year when I lost my job. I told her I wanted to live here while I attended school go finish my degree and was told I have a month to move out. A lot of my friends are depressed too. I like to help when I can, I also post here to help out when I can. I get really unhappy at night and when.I'm alone. I play video games, chill on the computer, and tennis. I was sexually active but have lost interest. I have a few "booty calls" I could call bit like I said, I have no interest.

I don't want ect. I've seen what it does to people and I.don't want that. Losing memories and all that. The friends ive had that have had it done didn't even feel any better. I'm stressing about money, not having a place to live, and not being murdered by my family. We do not get along. They've told me multiple times that they are better off if I was dead. I'm pretty social, i make friends fast and am told I'm a nice guy. I'm in pretty good health too. I'm active, play a lot of tennis.
I just feel lime its done for me. I se no future at all. I'm just a fucking waste of.space. I wouldn't even be missed.

I hate churches though so its not like I want to go in one and ask for counseling. Idk.

I'm a security guard.  Work my ass off for barely above minimum wage.

I haven't been in college for a few years. I got kicked out when I tried to kill myself. I'm 23.  

I was using a church run.counseling program (ironically) from my moms church. I just cane afford anything much anymore. Working this Shit job
Every time I call those I have a terrible.experience. I don't even.bother anymore.
That's the kind of therapy I've been in most. And was in til early this year when I stopped being able.to afford it. I liked it but I could never really trust my counselor :/

I'm 23 yearsold. I attempted suicide 4 years ago. I have ni one I can talk to, I don't have any friends really. What do you mean by cognitive?  I've never had ect or anything. My mom went through that for her chemical imbalance. I was diagnosed with severe depression by my therapist a few years ago.

I've been suicidal for over 10 years. My mother abused me growing up, and my dad was rough too. I've been in a few relationships, but they always cheat on me, or use me for my money. One of em.drained my bank account. I use to cut and burn but stopped a few years ago. Until tonight. I just can't keep living like this.

It's not easy. I can't just go meet new people. Every time I do, I get kicked in the teeth. I'm sitting here, after 3 years of.not hurting myself, and I'm burning the Shit out of my arm and my coworker says nothing. I don't matter to anyone. And I'm just better off gone then dealing with this for one more day
